chunks: Al-Husayn (ibn Abd al-Rahman) from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "When a man cuts the hair of his head or fastens it (in a bun) during Hajj or Umrah, shaving (the head) becomes obligatory upon him."

key_terms.عَقَصَ: To cut or trim the hair
key_terms.لَبَّدَ: To fasten or tie the hair (typically into a bun)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man cuts or ties his hair while in Ihram during Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the condition for the obligatory shaving (halq) is specified as the act of cutting or fastening (labbadahu) hair while in the state of Ihram, highlighting the precision required in ritual jurisprudence. This ruling is a key component of the expiation (kaffarah) for minor violations of Ihram conditions, reflecting the Imam's role in clarifying the practical application of Quranic injunctions. The emphasis on 'halq' (shaving) rather than mere trimming underscores the completeness of the ritual purification required to restore the pilgrim's state.
